title: Synthesis of aliphatic α-hydroxy carboxylic acids via electrocarboxylation of aldehydes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45724-45728
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07885G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Valtteri Oksanen, Kiia Malinen, Tom Wirtanen
A novel method for synthesis of aliphatic α-hydroxy acids is achieved via electrocarboxylation of aldehydes with CO2 in an undivided cell with stable carbon based electrodes.
